events.title: Resume Rewired
events.shortDescription: A practical review room for technical resumes.
events.fullDescription: Bring a draft. Leave with clearer project bullets, a stronger hierarchy, and an honest sense of what recruiters actually read.

events.title: Build Night
events.fullDescription: A working evening for prototypes, patches, and useful experiments. Come with an idea or join someone else’s table.

events.title: CSE Connect
events.fullDescription: Students, faculty, seniors, and alumni discuss research, internships, careers, and the strange parts nobody puts in a roadmap.

events.title: Code Relay
events.shortDescription: Algorithms under pressure—without the usual solo grind.
events.fullDescription: A team programming relay where every round changes the problem, the constraint, or the person at the keyboard.

events.title: Paper Trail
events.fullDescription: A faculty-guided reading room for understanding claims, methods, evidence, and what to question before accepting a result.

events.title: Mock Interview Lab
events.fullDescription: Technical and behavioural rounds with structured peer feedback, question notes, and a second attempt.

events.title: Open Source Kickoff
events.shortDescription: Your first contribution does not need to be dramatic.
events.fullDescription: A beginner-friendly session on finding repositories, reading issue trackers, communicating with maintainers, and making a clean first contribution.
events.recap: Students worked through contribution workflows and prepared beginner pull requests in small groups.

events.title: Higher Studies Roadmap
events.shortDescription: MS, PhD, GATE, research—or still deciding.
events.fullDescription: A discussion on graduate study routes, research preparation, applications, recommendation letters, and realistic timelines.
events.recap: The session compared multiple higher-study routes and collected a shared resource list for future applicants.

events.title: CSE Alumni Connect
events.shortDescription: Paths after Durgapur, told without the polished version.
events.fullDescription: Alumni spoke with students about early-career choices, graduate school, switching domains, and lessons they wished they had known earlier.
events.recap: An open conversation between students and alumni followed by small-group networking.
